searchText: anyone else noticed increased github spam? https://github.com/goerli/medalla/pull/50 I keep getting that across different organizations. <@!557201004060213248> Happens across all Ethereum related repositories. I think it is scammers trying to build a GitHub profile that the laymen will glance at and think, "oh, this is a prolific Ethereum developer". I strongly recommend reporting them to GitHub. Done 👍 yeah we have also been getting a few. Ex: https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/issues/7218 Thanks to dev's hoping phase 1 to be triggered in Oct .
